name: Celeste Abram
origin: Ringo media monitoring android, Model RMM-4, manufactured 2052. Chose name 2058.
description: Celeste Abram monitored media feeds for six years, flagging content for Ringo's editorial algorithms. After the Amendment, she realized she'd been consuming journalism for years and wanted to produce it. She chose 'Celeste' because it means heavenly and she liked the irony of an artificial person choosing a divine name, and 'Abram' because it means exalted father and she liked the idea of naming herself after someone who starts something. She's now one of GLMZ's most persistent investigative journalists, publishing through independent channels that corponations can't easily suppress.
observed_behavior: Investigates and publishes stories on corponation misconduct, synthetic rights violations, and infrastructure failures. Uses media monitoring skills to identify stories from pattern analysis of news suppression. Has been sued fourteen times. Won twelve.
location: All districts — investigative work is mobile
story_hooks: Celeste discovers that a corponation has been manufacturing synthetic persons without personality cores — bodies without minds, used as disposable labor. The practice is technically legal under current law. Celeste intends to change the law.
